notes.title: Windows 10 update!
notes.content:
The "Windows 10 bug" that caused the game to run in 1-2 fps have finally been fixed!

It's taken an insane amount of time, much due to the aging engines incompatibility and partly a shortage of time on my own part.
There's been a lot of support, help and fixes from the community and after much testing and troubleshooting we finally have a new Launcher that fixes the Windows 10 vs DX9 incompatibility. 

Thank you Community for all the troubleshooting and support! 
And thank you Markus Hohmann, without your help I'll probably still be walking in circles.

notes.title: Blackbay Asylum Version 1.3 is now Available!
notes.content:
After a long wait, the stars are finally aligned and the 1.3 update is here. Unfortunately I was not able to add achievements as it would require hiring outside help to create custom channels for the game engine, which the asylum can't afford.

[h1]This update contains:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Alternate controls. "WASD", Arrow buttons and both shift keys.
    [*]New puzzle added to replace one of the less inventive ones.
    [*]New/changed journal entries added.
    [*]A few updated/corrected textures.
    [*]Corrected spelling/grammar.
    [*](Probably still some errors left...lots of text and no spell check function in the engine)
[/list]


Enjoy the madness!
